findings.description: Interpreter assumes handling of non-numeric or missing Circuit Height inputs (e.g., treat as zero or display validation error) but the ticket does not specify any validation behavior.
Interpreter adds a requirement to define precision/rounding rules for the summed DX Coil Height, which is not mentioned in the ticket.
Ticket does not specify the unit of measurement for Circuit Height; interpreter lists this as an ambiguity but does not include it as a required specification.
Interpreter does not address how the list of Cooling Circuits is initially populated (data source/API), which is a missing requirement from the ticket.
